Do not invent passing runtime tests.", "source": {"before": {"revision": "04f7f55a7b5ddb2ecd79a8d813b2256c1113b8a9", "path": "middleware/wrap_writer.go", "selected_lines": [211, 226], "source": "211: func (f *httpFancyWriter) ReadFrom(r io.Reader) (int64, error) {
212: 	if f.basicWriter.tee != nil || f.basicWriter.discard {

215: 		// straight to the original ResponseWriter). basicWriter.Write already
216: 		// increments basicWriter.bytes, so we must NOT add n again here (that
217: 		// would double-count).
218: 		n, err := io.Copy(&f.basicWriter, r)
219: 		return n, err
220: 	}
221: 	rf := f.basicWriter.ResponseWriter.(io.ReaderFrom)
222: 	f.basicWriter.maybeWriteHeader()
223: 	n, err := rf.ReadFrom(r)
224: 	f.basicWriter.bytes += int(n)
225: 	return n, err
226: }"}, "after": {"revision": "9f8adb1aabaa8a91180a821111d3f8e668d1c0bf", "path": "middleware/wrap_writer.go", "selected_lines": [211, 229], "source": "211: func (f *httpFancyWriter) ReadFrom(r io.Reader) (int64, error) {
